name: Dia
statusNote: Generally available for macOS with frequent releases and paid plans; Windows support is in progress.

macos.note: Generally available for Apple silicon Macs on macOS 14 or later; Intel Macs are not supported.

windows.note: No stable public Windows support is established here.

linux.note: No official Linux release is listed.

android.note: No official Android release is listed.

ios.note: No official iOS release is listed.

availability.cpuNotes: Desktop builds target Apple silicon hardware.

foundation.codeLicense: Chromium base with proprietary Dia interface and AI services

telemetry.note: AI products can process prompts and page context; consult Dia's current privacy documentation.

trackerBlocking.note: No stable blocker policy is asserted for the experimental product.

fingerprintingProtections.note: No hardened fingerprinting posture is documented here.

privacy.privateWindows: Private mode, where available, should not be treated as protection from AI-service processing or network observation.

vpnOrProxy.note: No general browser VPN is included.

manifestV2.note: Dia's release notes state Manifest V2 extensions are disabled.

manifestV3.note: Chromium-based Manifest V3 support is expected, subject to release behavior.

extensions.limitations: Do not migrate a critical extension workflow without testing the current build.

nativeContentBlocking.note: No stable native blocking commitment is asserted.

verticalTabs.note: Dia uses a redesigned, sidebar-oriented tab workflow.

workspaces.note: Workspace behavior is subject to the current product scope.

profiles.note: Profiles with quick switching are documented.

splitView.note: Split panes are documented, opened from the View menu or a shortcut.

readerMode.note: Reader mode is available through an extension.

commandPalette.note: The address-bar AI surface is not a command palette for browser actions.

translation.note: A built-in translation feature is documented.

pwa.note: Progressive web apps are supported by the Chromium install flow.

assistant.note: Dia provides a built-in assistant surface.

summarization.note: Dia documents page or multi-tab summarisation.

agenticActions.note: Dia documents Skills and agent systems but does not document the assistant clicking or filling forms on a page.

aiSearch.note: Dia documents AI-assisted answers in search or the address bar.

contentGeneration.note: Dia documents text or image generation.

aiPrivacyControls.note: Dia documents retention, training or kill-switch controls.

crossTabContext.note: Dia documents awareness of multiple tabs or history.

voiceMultimodal.note: Voice or image interaction is not documented.

dataSaver.note: No documented data-saving or compression mode.

mobileExtensions.note: Extension support on mobile is not documented.

downloadManager.note: A built-in download manager is not documented.

backgroundMedia.note: Background or picture-in-picture playback is not documented.

webPush.note: Web push support is not documented.
